I am extremely disappointed with my experience with Boost Solar. They initially promised a 10-day installation (3-4 weeks in the agreement), yet more than four months passed with no visible progress. Repeated attempts to reach out went unanswered, with no clear timeline or updates provided. Their lack of communication was incredibly frustrating, and I can’t recommend them if you’re looking for reliability.Installation finally happened—but only after I waited 125 days and posted a 1-star review on Google. Unfortunately, installation day was even more chaotic. The installer demanded an additional $700, claiming the agreed-upon layout required 15 extra meters of wiring. Fortunately, I had shared photos of my house layout and electrical points before signing the agreement and had an email confirming there would be no extra charges.After the installation, staff from Boost Solar contacted me, insisting I immediately change my review to 5 stars. I explained that I wanted to verify everything first, but just three days later, they began pressuring me again, even saying I was “doing wrong” by not updating my review. I responded that if I could wait 125 days, they could certainly wait a few hours. Then someone higher up from Boost Solar called, claiming they had upgraded my system due to the delay and had waived the additional charges, and he asked me to revise my rating. When I told him I had only received what was originally agreed upon, he became confrontational, warning me of “consequences” if I didn’t comply and threatening that I would regret it. He even sent a WhatsApp message threatening a defamation lawsuit and called me “shameless” over the phone.Then they claimed he had recordings of our conversations and would present them in court, so I encouraged him to do so for transparency. I even invited him to share those recordings publicly for clarity. He then threatened to withhold servicing of my solar equipment and said he’d blacklist my name with other solar providers. When I reminded him of their obligation to provide service as per our agreement, he taunted me about my net meter not being connected yet, implying I wouldn’t benefit from feed-in tariffs.Since then, I have also had trouble accessing the SEMS portal to monitor my solar system’s performance. After multiple emails requesting assistance, I received no response until they called me again on 26-Nov-2024—this time to pressure me into removing my review, rather than addressing the issue with the portal. To make matters worse, the equipment information that was previously visible on the SEMS portal has mysteriously disappeared, leaving me unable to monitor the system's performance at all. This sudden and unexplained missing data is deeply concerning.This behavior continues to be unprofessional and only adds to my frustration.Initially, my review stemmed from frustration over the delay and lack of communication. After the installation, I had planned to verify everything and update my review once I returned from personal leave, as I rarely leave reviews, especially negative ones. However, the pressure and intimidation I’ve faced since then have been disturbing. I now feel strongly that my review reflects my honest experience, and no one should be pressured or intimidated into leaving a favorable review. Genuine feedback should be respected.

The sales process proved to be quite straightforward and hassle-free. A family member referred me, and I was offered a discount. While there was some sales pressure, especially when I inquired about an alternative inverter and panel system as recommended by SolarQuotes, my request was dismissed in favor of their preferred SolaX and Seraphim panels. This made me a bit uneasy, but the offered quote was very competitive, so I proceeded with the contract.It's essential to carefully review the contract because initially, I was told to make a full payment before installation. However, the contract outlined progress payments, and I communicated this to Jeff, who promptly agreed to the adjusted terms.I was impressed with the understanding and patience displayed by the Boost Solar team when I had to reschedule my installation twice. This level of customer service was greatly appreciated.The installation of the 20 panels was completed in half a day, but I noticed some debris on the roof afterward, such as wrappers, cigarette butts, metal shavings, and cable ties. It's important to thoroughly inspect and clean the roof to remove all these remnants. I also discovered a couple of cracked tiles, which I had to repair myself. It's unfortunate that this was not mentioned earlier, but I understand it can be challenging to spot such issues when they are painted and exposed to direct sunlight.On a positive note, the inverter was installed with great workmanship, and I am very satisfied with the quality of the work. Offering a 12-year warranty on the inverter and a 25-year warranty on the panels provides substantial peace of mind regarding the manufacturer's product quality. The quality of support from Boost Solar will only be known over time, should the need arise.In summary, our overall experience was positive, and we highly recommend their services to others.
